resources.string: Choose a mode, then use the paired receiving phone to call a third phone. Keep this sending phone out of earshot. Speak one at a time on the receiving phone and the third phone. End the call, return here, and save what each person could hear clearly. Repeat with the other mode.
Connect the receiving phone and enable Call alerts, Call control, and two-way call audio before testing.
